message.content:
**Pantone Color Code for “Sky Blue”**

| Reference | Pantone Code |
|-----------|--------------|
| **Standard Sky Blue** | **PANTONE 14‑4318 TCX** |

> *“Sky Blue”* is commonly identified as PANTONE 14‑4318 TCX in the Pantone Matching System (PMS).  
> 
> If you’re looking at older catalogs or alternative naming conventions, you may also see it listed under:
> - **PANTONE 15‑3919 TPX** (“Bright Sky Blue”)  
> - **PANTONE 12‑5900 TCX** (“Soft Sky Blue”), depending on the exact hue desired.

If you have a particular application or design requirement, let me know—different industries sometimes use slightly varied shades labeled as “sky blue.”
